division.bro.official.pc-2018-42.note: Season 42 ran Update 42.1 through 42.3. End is when PC servers go down for the 43.1 maintenance (2026-09-10 00:00 UTC) -- the last moment it can be played. Servers return ~8.5 h later, at 08:30 UTC, and Update 43.1 opens Season 43.

division.bro.official.pc-2018-43.note: Start is official: Update 43.1 becomes available when the maintenance completes. End is derived from the in-game season timer, read 2026-09-10 09:12 UTC as 54 d 14 h 48 m remaining, which lands exactly on 2026-11-04 00:00 UTC -- the same midnight-maintenance shape as Season 42's end, which is what makes the arithmetic trustworthy. That makes Season 43 55 days against Season 42's 85: PUBG season lengths are not a fixed cycle, which is why there is no cycleDays fallback here. Confirmed by the Update 44.1 patch notes, which put the PC maintenance at 2026-11-04 00:00-08:30 UTC.

division.bro.official.pc-2018-44.note: Start is official: the Update 44.1 patch notes schedule the PC maintenance for 2026-11-04 00:00-08:30 UTC, and Season 44 opens when it completes. End is derived from the in-game season timer, read 2026-11-04 10:57 UTC as 62 d 13 h 3 m remaining, which lands on 2027-01-06 00:00 UTC -- the same midnight-maintenance shape as the ends of Seasons 42 and 43. About 63 days, between Season 43's 55 and Season 42's 85.
